parsed.notes:
The posting has no section headings, so the sentence 'requiring strong SQL and Python skills and experience with ...' is read as the requirements and every item in it is required.
SQL and Python are asked for together ('X and Y'), so they form no alternative_group.
'AI agents, semantic models, and text-to-SQL tooling' appear only as responsibilities ('You will create'), so they are not labeled.
'blends data engineering with AI' describes the role, not something asked of the candidate, so it is not labeled.
The posting names Snowflake only in the title, the company description and the platform ('Snowflake AI Data Cloud'). The ask itself is 'Cortex components', and a specific skill does not imply its parent, so snowflake is not labeled. A reviewer may disagree, since Cortex is a Snowflake product.
Cortex and Semantic Views have no taxonomy entry, so they are listed in unmapped.
No seniority signal: 'production AI solutions' is ownership/production language, not a level signal. No German mention. No degree mention.
